title: A haunted museum is opening inside a Victorian arcade on Friday the 13th
excerpt: A haunted museum is opening inside a Victorian arcade. Prepare to be scared!
content:
A haunted museum is opening inside a Victorian arcade.

The museum will open at That’s the Spirit, a paranormal-themed shop in Newport Arcade, on Friday, November 13.

The shop opened on Halloween and has been transforming its upstairs space for the attraction.

That’s the Spirit said: "Behind the scenes, something rather magical (and perhaps a little spooky!) has been happening upstairs.

"Our new space is currently undergoing a major transformation, and we can't wait to show you what we've been creating."

The museum will form part of a wider offering, with spaces for readings, healing, classes and workshops.

The team said the museum would introduce visitors to "some of the spirits who call the arcade and museum home."

The launch event will run from 7.30pm to 10pm on Friday, November 13.

Entry is free, but visitors must book in advance.

Opening night will feature music, treats, activities and "spooky surprises."

That’s the Spirit has already started investigating its new surroundings.

The business held its first ghost hunt at Newport Arcade on October 30, from 8pm to 2am.

Guests took part in vigils, table-tipping, glass-tipping and other paranormal experiments.

Nathan and Chloe, owners of new paranormal-themed shop, That’s The Spirit, in Newport Arcade, are opening their own haunted museum (Image: Supplied)

The arcade has a long history.

Built in 1893 during a major redevelopment of upper High Street, Newport Arcade was designed in the French Renaissance style by Habershon and Fawckner.

The Grade II-listed arcade links High Street with Cambrian Road and has a glazed roof, upper galleries and a bridge.

It has housed a range of businesses over the years.

1946 records list tailors, a bootmaker, leather-goods specialists, a dairy, and Stanley Jones’s stationery, book and music warehouse among its tenants.

The arcade has since enjoyed a revival, with new independent businesses moving in.

That’s the Spirit will host more events there, including the Dark Market on November 20.

The market will feature alternative and paranormal stalls, tarot and mediumship, live music and food.

First comes the haunted museum—a fitting addition to the arcade’s growing attractions and colourful past.

The shop will also serve as the base for That’s the Spirit’s paranormal investigations and ghost hunts at locations across the UK.
